title: Nourishing Crisp Uruguayan Lamb Bake
description: A flavorful, winey Uruguayan-inspired lamb bake featuring sweet figs and flambéed onions, perfect for post-workout dinner or a keto-friendly meal.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, and chili powder.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the red wine to the pot and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add the figs, thyme, and browned lamb shoulder to the pot.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
